articles.title: Subject matter
articles.requirement: Establishes scope — rules on AML/CFT for obliged entities

articles.title: Obliged entities
articles.requirement: Defines which entities are in scope (credit institutions, payment institutions, CASPs, etc.)

articles.title: Definitions
articles.requirement: Defines beneficial owner, PEP, business relationship, occasional transaction, etc.

articles.title: Risk-based approach
articles.requirement: Obliged entities must apply risk-based approach to AML/CFT measures — proportionate to identified risks

articles.title: ML/TF risk assessment
articles.requirement: Identify and assess ML/TF risks at business-wide level; document, keep current, review on trigger events

articles.title: Risk factors
articles.requirement: Consider customer, product, geographic, channel, and transaction risk factors; refer to Annex I-III

articles.title: Group-wide risk assessment
articles.requirement: Group-level ML/TF risk assessment covering all subsidiaries and branches

articles.title: Group-wide policies and controls
articles.requirement: Group-wide AML/CFT policies, procedures, controls; share information within group

articles.title: Policies and procedures
articles.requirement: Internal AML/CFT policies and procedures; documented, proportionate, regularly reviewed

articles.title: Customer due diligence
articles.requirement: Apply CDD measures for new business relationships, occasional transactions ≥€10k, and on suspicion

articles.title: Application of CDD measures
articles.requirement: Timing and manner of CDD application; verification before/at start of business relationship

articles.title: Enhanced due diligence
articles.requirement: EDD triggers: high-risk third countries, PEPs, complex/unusual transactions, high-risk factors

articles.title: Simplified due diligence
articles.requirement: SDD permitted for lower-risk relationships; conditions and limits; not a blanket exemption

articles.title: Identification of customer
articles.requirement: Collect identifying information: name, DOB, nationality, address, ID document

articles.title: Verification of customer identity
articles.requirement: Verify identity through reliable, independent sources; document basis for verification

articles.title: Beneficial ownership
articles.requirement: Identify and verify beneficial owner (>25% threshold); understand ownership/control structure

articles.title: Understanding business relationship
articles.requirement: Understand purpose and intended nature of business relationship; obtain relevant information

articles.title: Ongoing monitoring
articles.requirement: Ongoing monitoring of business relationship; scrutiny of transactions throughout; keep CDD current

articles.title: Timing of verification
articles.requirement: Verification must be completed before/at start of relationship; exceptions for low-risk in limited cases

articles.title: Inability to apply CDD
articles.requirement: Exit relationship if CDD cannot be completed; file STR if appropriate; do not establish relationship

articles.title: Reliance on third parties
articles.requirement: May rely on third parties for CDD; responsibility remains with obliged entity; specific conditions apply

articles.title: Outsourcing
articles.requirement: May outsource CDD activities; liability remains; must monitor and audit outsourced providers

articles.title: Politically exposed persons
articles.requirement: PEP definition: domestic/foreign PEPs, international organisations; identify at onboarding and ongoing

articles.title: Family members and close associates of PEPs
articles.requirement: Extend PEP measures to immediate family and known close associates

articles.title: EDD for PEPs
articles.requirement: Senior management approval; enhanced ongoing monitoring; source of wealth and funds; no default termination

articles.title: De-risking of PEPs
articles.requirement: Cannot terminate solely on PEP status; must conduct individual risk assessment; document rationale

articles.title: Former PEPs
articles.requirement: Apply risk-based approach to former PEPs; minimum 12 months after leaving office for full de-listing

articles.title: High-risk third countries
articles.requirement: Apply EDD to transactions/relationships involving FATF high-risk or equivalent countries; enhanced measures

articles.title: Measures for high-risk third countries
articles.requirement: Specific EDD measures: senior management approval; source of funds; enhanced ongoing monitoring

articles.title: Correspondent banking
articles.requirement: Specific requirements for cross-border correspondent relationships; assess respondent's AML controls

articles.title: Payable-through accounts
articles.requirement: Additional requirements for payable-through accounts in correspondent banking context

articles.title: Anonymous accounts
articles.requirement: Prohibition on anonymous accounts/passbooks; existing ones must be subject to CDD before use

articles.title: Shell banks
articles.requirement: Prohibition on correspondent relationships with shell banks

articles.title: Private banking
articles.requirement: Enhanced measures for private banking; senior management sign-off; source of wealth

articles.title: Nominee shareholders
articles.requirement: Where nominee shareholders/directors used, obtain information on beneficial owner behind nominee

articles.title: Life insurance and investments
articles.requirement: CDD on beneficiaries and beneficial owners of life insurance/investment products at pay-out

articles.title: Currency exchange
articles.requirement: CDD requirements for currency exchange at €1,000 threshold

articles.title: Crypto-asset service providers
articles.requirement: Specific CDD requirements for CASPs; Travel Rule compliance; wallet address screening

articles.title: Suspicious transaction reporting — internal
articles.requirement: Employees must report suspicions to compliance officer (MLRO) promptly; no tipping-off

articles.title: Reporting to FIU
articles.requirement: File STR with national FIU when suspicion arises; do so without delay; no tipping-off

articles.title: Content of STR
articles.requirement: STR must include all relevant information; cooperate with FIU requests; provide supplementary info

articles.title: Tipping-off prohibition
articles.requirement: Prohibition on disclosing that STR filed or investigation ongoing; exceptions for group/professional contexts

articles.title: Non-execution of transactions
articles.requirement: May proceed with transaction if deferral would compromise investigation; report to FIU and document

articles.title: Liability exemption
articles.requirement: Good-faith STR filers exempt from liability; protection for employees who report internally

articles.title: Annual reporting
articles.requirement: Annual submission to FIU of statistical data on STRs, dissemination decisions, freezings

articles.title: FIU cooperation
articles.requirement: Obliged entities must cooperate with FIU requests; respond within defined timeframes

articles.title: Sanctions screening
articles.requirement: Screen customers and counterparties against EU, UN, and national sanctions lists

articles.title: Asset freezing
articles.requirement: Immediately freeze assets of designated persons; report to competent authority; no delay permitted

articles.title: Reporting of freezing
articles.requirement: Report frozen assets and freeze actions to competent authority within defined timeframe

articles.title: Sanctions evasion
articles.requirement: Identify and report suspected sanctions evasion; implement evasion-detection typologies

articles.title: Internal controls
articles.requirement: Effective internal AML/CFT controls; compliance function; independent audit; MLRO appointment

articles.title: Compliance officer
articles.requirement: Designate compliance officer (MLRO) at management level; sufficient authority and resources

articles.title: Employee vetting
articles.requirement: Fit and proper requirements for employees in AML-relevant roles; criminal record checks

articles.title: Training
articles.requirement: Regular AML/CFT training for all relevant staff; role-specific training; document attendance

articles.title: Whistleblower protection
articles.requirement: Confidential channel for reporting breaches; protection from retaliation; anonymous reporting option

articles.title: Management body responsibility
articles.requirement: Management body responsible for AML/CFT strategy; annual review; senior manager accountability

articles.title: AML/CFT strategy
articles.requirement: Board-approved AML/CFT strategy; cascaded to business units; reviewed annually or on trigger

articles.title: Risk appetite
articles.requirement: Defined AML/CFT risk appetite; approved by board; aligned to business model and risk profile

articles.title: Business-wide risk assessment — update
articles.requirement: BWRA updated at least every 2 years and on material change; benchmarked against sectoral/national assessment

articles.title: Record keeping — CDD
articles.requirement: Retain CDD records for at least 5 years from end of business relationship (max 10); accessible to authorities

articles.title: Record keeping — transactions
articles.requirement: Retain transaction records for at least 5 years from completion; accessible to authorities

articles.title: Record keeping — STRs
articles.requirement: Retain STR filings and supporting documentation; restricted access; data protection compliance

articles.title: Data protection
articles.requirement: AML data processing must comply with GDPR; limited purpose; no dual use for commercial purposes

articles.title: Beneficial ownership registers
articles.requirement: Entities must maintain accurate BO information; update within defined timeframes; cooperate with registry

articles.title: Transaction monitoring systems
articles.requirement: Effective TM systems proportionate to risk profile; detect unusual patterns; tune alerts regularly

articles.title: TM alert handling
articles.requirement: Procedures for handling TM alerts; escalation to MLRO; document decision and rationale

articles.title: TM parameters
articles.requirement: Defined TM scenarios and thresholds; regular review; benchmarked against typologies

articles.title: Cash transactions
articles.requirement: CDD and reporting for cash transactions ≥€10k (or lower national threshold)

articles.title: Real estate
articles.requirement: CDD and enhanced scrutiny for high-value real estate transactions; check for complex ownership structures

articles.title: Crypto-assets monitoring
articles.requirement: Transaction monitoring for crypto-asset transfers; Travel Rule compliance; unhosted wallet screening

articles.title: Trade finance
articles.requirement: AML/CFT measures for trade finance; over/under-invoicing detection; beneficial ownership of counterparties

articles.title: FIU feedback
articles.requirement: FIUs provide feedback to obliged entities on quality of STRs; entities use feedback to improve

articles.title: National risk assessment alignment
articles.requirement: Obliged entities have regard to national risk assessment in their own risk assessment

articles.title: Sector risk assessment
articles.requirement: Supervisors publish sector-specific risk assessments; obliged entities apply findings

articles.title: AMLA joint guidelines
articles.requirement: AMLA issues guidelines on RBA; entities must have regard to AMLA guidance

articles.title: Cooperation with authorities
articles.requirement: Respond to competent authority requests promptly; provide records and information

articles.title: Supervisory access
articles.requirement: Supervisors have right of access to premises, systems, and records; entities must cooperate

articles.title: Sanctions — administrative
articles.requirement: Administrative sanctions regime; pecuniary penalties; public statement; withdrawal of authorisation

articles.title: Penalties
articles.requirement: Minimum penalty levels for serious, systematic, or repeated AML breaches; up to €10M or 10% of turnover

articles.title: Publication of decisions
articles.requirement: Supervisors publish enforcement decisions; 'name and shame' regime; specified retention period

articles.title: Reporting breaches — internal
articles.requirement: Internal breach reporting channels; protection for reporters; management body notification

articles.title: Cross-border cooperation
articles.requirement: Cooperation between home/host supervisors; AMLA colleges; information exchange protocols

articles.title: Entry into force
articles.requirement: Entry into force 20 days after publication; applies from 10 July 2027

articles.title: Transitional provisions
articles.requirement: Transitional arrangements for existing relationships and systems; review within 12 months

articles.title: Review clause
articles.requirement: Commission to review and report on application by 2030; consider extension to new sectors

articles.title: Repeal
articles.requirement: AMLD4 and AMLD5 repealed; references to repealed directives to be read as references to AMLR
